data.title: 提丰 · 书店里选下次一起去的地方
data.description: 周末书店的旅行书架前，提丰穿灰呢短外套与莓紫长裙，抱着一本打开的图册。她用指尖点着湖边木屋的照片，把书页朝你倾斜，眼神询问你愿不愿意一起去。
data.action: 抱着打开的图册，指向湖边木屋照片并向你展示
data.mood: 认真规划共同出游的期待
data.promptProse: In front of the travel-book shelves, Typhon holds an atlas open and points to a photograph of a lakeside cabin, tilting the spread so her companion can see it. Keep her charcoal wool jacket, ivory blouse and berry-purple midi skirt in the eye-level cowboy composition. The near corner of the atlas overlaps her jacket; rows of book spines continue behind her to a shelf end that reveals a narrow aisle. Diffuse window light makes the open pages the brightest local surface and gives the silver jacket toggles small, soft reflections. Her fingertip casts a short shadow beside the photograph, and the shelf recesses become darker toward the aisle.
